'''Joiya Byir''' was a [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref/book|4|5}} She was also [[Black Ajah]] and a member of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]]

== Appearance and Personality ==
Joiya appeared to be a handsome woman, with a friendly, motherly face, dark gray eyes and dark hair.

==Strength and Abilities==
Joiya is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|weak]] in the [[One Power]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of {{opsl|34}}. She was the weakest among [[Liandrin's group of Black Sisters]].

== History ==
Joiya was 171 years old when she died. She was born in {{ne|828}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|844}}. After spending nine years as a [[novice]] and eleven years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the [[shawl]] in {{ne|864}}.

== Activities ==
She was found by [[Egwene al'Vere]] in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' while she was dreaming. Egwene cut her from the [[True Source]] and bound her in [[Air]], leaving her in the world of dreams.{{ref/book|3|54}}

She was held prisoner in the [[Stone of Tear]] and questioned by Egwene, [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] on the whereabouts of the Black Ajah now. She told them they plan to use [[Mazrim Taim]] as a [[False Dragon]] and unleash destruction on all the nations but to call himself [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|4|5}} Because she was still bound by her oaths to the [[Shadow]], she could not tell the truth about this.

=== Murder ===
She was murdered during the [[Trolloc]] attack on the Stone, along with [[Amico Nagoyin]], by [[Slayer]], who cut their throats after nailing their tongues to the cell door.{{ref/book|4|12}}{{ref/book|9|22}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Joiya Byir}}

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Joiya Byir}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Joelle}}.

==Errata==
In early printings of the [[The Dragon Reborn]], Joiya is stated to be White Ajah and the eldest of the Black sisters that fled the Tower and old enough to be Egwene's grandmother. These are both incorrect as it is stated that two of each Ajah except for the [[Red Ajah]] fled the Tower. Since [[Rianna Andomeran]] and [[Falion Bhoda]] are both White Ajah and there is only one Gray sister, [[Temaile Kinderode]], this was corrected in later printings. Her age was also corrected to be "old enough to be her grandmother's grandmother". The Kramer/Reading audiobook also contains these errors.
